Meta.title: Christna Etienne — Computer Scientist
Meta.description: Portfolio of Christna Etienne, computer scientist and CEO of Vunep, specializing in databases, systems, and digital platform administration.

Hero.lead: Computer scientist in advanced training (Bachelor's in Computer Science, software engineering training at Master's 1 level), currently pursuing a postgraduate diploma (DESS) in Information Technology at UNITECH-BRH. As CEO of Vunep, she puts her skills to work in IT support, systems administration, and digital platform operations.

About.title: Profile
About.sub: Serious, dynamic, and organized, with a focus on databases, systems, and cybersecurity.
About.body: Holder of a Bachelor's in Computer Science and software engineering training equivalent to a Master's 1 (Université INUKA), Christna is currently pursuing a postgraduate diploma in Information Technology at UNITECH-BRH. She has solid knowledge of databases, computer systems, networks, development tools, GIS (geographic information systems), and technical environments — gained notably through an internship at Haiti's National Center for Geospatial Information (CNIGS) and her experience as a science teacher.
